stories.headline: Nvidia sees 70% growth as AI spending surges
stories.summary: Nvidia forecast roughly 70% revenue growth for its next fiscal year, far above Wall Street expectations, as demand for AI computing broadens. Memory shortages and China export restrictions remain important constraints.

stories.headline: Meta agrees to $18 billion youth-safety settlement
stories.summary: Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion and impose tighter limits on teenage Facebook and Instagram use to settle claims brought by nearly all U.S. states. Meta denied wrongdoing; several states remain outside the agreement.

stories.headline: Nepal floods leave nearly 1,500 missing
stories.summary: The reported death toll from catastrophic Himalayan flooding rose above 160, with nearly 1,500 people missing, including foreign tourists. Rescue operations continue, and the casualty figures remain fluid.

stories.headline: Russia strikes Kyiv, ports and industrial sites
stories.summary: Russian missiles and drones struck Kyiv and other Ukrainian targets, including ports, grain storage, energy and industrial sites. Damage was reported at civilian facilities; the full casualty picture was still developing.

stories.headline: Iran war reaches six months without clear end
stories.summary: Six months after U.S. and Israeli strikes began, Iran has not surrendered, Strait of Hormuz shipping remains disrupted, and no clear route to ending the conflict is visible. Reuters characterizes the war as an unpopular stalemate.
